title: MergeRelationCandidatesRequest
description: Request body for mergeRelationCandidates (optional authoring). This operation SHOULD require explicit review authorization and MUST NOT merge candidates if an identity-relevant qualifier is unresolved (`unknown`).

relationIds.description: The relation candidates to merge. All MUST be merge-compatible per spec/03.

targetRelationId.description: Optional identifier of the surviving relation; if omitted the server assigns/selects one.

reason.description: Rationale for the merge (recorded in provenance/review).
